C0948.title: Cross-border gambling ring with 3 billion yuan turnover busted in Wushen Banner, 17 arrested
C0948.summary: In 2022, Uxin Banner Public Security Bureau cracked a major cross-border online gambling case and arrested 17 people involved. The criminal group used online platforms to organize cross-border gambling, with fund flows exceeding 3 billion yuan. It was one of the 2022 cases cracked by Uxin Banner police with the largest number of people involved and the highest fund flow, reflecting how cross-border gambling platforms expand harm through online payments, agent recruitment, and fund splitting.
